model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port keep in Event) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port metric out Snapshot) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block ShadowRouter
      (implements Observable)
      (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
    (block RetryParser
      (port done out Snapshot)
      (implements Durable)
      (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
      (level
        (block RemoteIndex
          (port emit out Receipt)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
        (block RetryMetrics
          (port emit out Command)
          (implements Durable)
          (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
        (block RemoteCache
          (port evt in Request)
          (port out out Event)
          (implements Observable)
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
          (level
            (block Cache
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block ShadowSearch
              (port evt in Command)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
            (adjacent
              (block BatchCatalog
                (port done out Receipt)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
              (block LiveSession
                (port evt in Event)
                (port emit out Command)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Editor
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
          (level
            (block ShadowQueue
              (port done out Receipt)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))))
  (level
    (block LocalBilling
      (port evt in Receipt)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
      (level
        (adjacent
          (block BatchUploader :type "Process"
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block Metrics
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                (block ShadowLedger
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteRenderer
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteMailer :type "Feature"
                  (port in in Request)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))
          (block RetryAuth
            (port req in Request)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (block RemoteQueue
                (port req in Receipt)
                (port out out Command)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
          (block ShadowMailer
            (port emit out Request)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeEditor :type "Service"
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteSearch :type "Store"
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block LiveQueue
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))))
          (block RemoteFeed
            (port req in Event)
            (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
        (adjacent
          (block Mailer
            (port evt in Event)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block EdgeSync :type "Feature"
            (port evt in Request)
            (port done out Receipt)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
          (block BatchPlanner
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block ShadowPricing :type "Store"
            (port done out Event)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
        (block RemoteParser :type "Feature"
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))
      (level
        (block RetryMailer
          (port out out Event)
          (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
          (level
            (block LiveFeed
              (port emit out Event)
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
            (block BatchInbox
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block EdgeAudit
              (port out out Command)
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
          (level
            (block RemoteAudit
              (port req in Event)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))))))
